_jump: The ENGINE's own account of the jump, recorded so a later reader can check the claim without re-running the game. The fuel bill equalling the distance is the INDEPENDENT witness: it arrives through the fuel accounting rather than through system.ID, so an engine that moved the player without jumping does not satisfy it.
_scenario_knobs: The knobs this golden was BLESSED with. gate_002_spec.py requires spec.json to equal them EXACTLY. A fresh-run-vs-golden comparison cannot catch a changed seed, because changing the seed changes BOTH sides; agreement with this record makes drift fatal while keeping a governed re-bless legal.
_stability: Every run's outcome is recorded regardless of exit code. A REFUSAL (the harness declining to dump an unsettled world) is not a DIFFERENCE; collapsing the two is how a stability claim goes dishonest. distinct_frame_digests is recorded but NOT asserted - see frame_digest_asserted.
_what_this_file_is: The witness that lives OUTSIDE state.json. A golden cannot witness itself: any digest stored INSIDE state.json moves when state.json is edited, so both sides of a self-comparison change together and nothing goes red. Every predicate gate_002_spec.py and gate_002_evidence.py make about the blessed artifacts is anchored here.
frame_digest_why_not_asserted: llvmpipe is not bit-reproducible: the 10-run sweep produced 10 distinct frame digests for ONE identical dump digest. Byte-comparing the grid would flake forever on renderer noise. The dump is byte-hashed BECAUSE it is quantised and deterministic; the frame is not. The frame.grid sha256 above is recorded for forensics and explicitly marked asserted:false.

frame_liveness._floor: Half the spread MEASURED on the blessed frame, not a magic number. Liveness is the one frame property a dead run cannot fake: a run that died before drawing yields a uniform grid whose spread is ~0. The floor sits far below the measured value so renderer noise cannot trip it, and far above 0 so an undrawn frame cannot pass.

market_projection.measured: Across 8 consecutive runs BEFORE the projection, every field of the dump agreed EXCEPT market.*, which differed in 26-30 fields each run. After the projection, 10/10 runs produced one identical dump digest.
market_projection.reason: Arriving in a system rebuilds the commodity market (Universe.m:7997-7998 destroys commodityMarket and calls -generateMarketForSystemWithEconomy:andScript:), pricing and stocking each good with base*random*(randf()-randf()) (OOCommodities.m:423,442,544,567). randf() draws from the global RANROT stream whose position depends on elapsed frames, so the per-good values move with frame count rather than with the seed.
market_projection.why_not_deleted: A deleted market would make an arrival with NO market indistinguishable from a healthy one, and an absent market is exactly what a half-completed arrival produces. The good count and sorted good names are fixed by Resources/Config/commodities.plist, not by any random draw, so they remain a positive witness.
